description: This file is a shell script that defines multiple functions for git tag manipulation, commit management, date handling, error suppression, and test automation. It appears to be a utility script used in a larger project to automate git operations and testing.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Verifies existence of a specified git tag and outputs its revision SHA1.

methods.name: unique_commit
methods.description: Creates a unique commit based on input text and a tree specified by tag.

methods.name: save_tag
methods.description: Updates a git tag to a new commit, prepends a sed script to a temporary sed script file, and replaces the original sed script.

methods.name: entag
methods.description: Replaces sha1 hashes with symbolic references using a sed script.

methods.name: as_author
methods.description: Runs a command with GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL set to a specified value, restoring the original after execution.

methods.name: commit_date
methods.description: Extracts the commit date (timestamp) of a specified commit SHA.

methods.name: assign_fake_date
methods.description: Assigns a fake date to a variable, handling partial date formats.

methods.name: on_committer_date
methods.description: Runs a command with GIT_COMMITTER_DATE temporarily set to a specified date.

methods.name: on_dates
methods.description: Runs a command with both GIT_COMMITTER_DATE and GIT_AUTHOR_DATE temporarily set to specified dates.

methods.name: hide_error
methods.description: Executes a command while suppressing any error output.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Checks the output of a command against an expected value and compares actual vs. expected output files.

methods.name: name_from_description
methods.description: Converts a string description into a sanitized test name by replacing non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens.

methods.name: test_output_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that runs a command and verifies its output matches expectations.
